ai_summary: Astra Microwave Products Limited (AMP) is strategically demerging its space and weather business into Astra Space Technologies Limited (ASTL) to enable focused growth for both entities. AMP's core defense and aerospace business delivered record H1 FY27 EBITDA and PAT margins (27.4% and 13% respectively), supported by a robust INR 4,708 crore consolidated order book (including a INR 220 crore ASTL order book) and a strategic shift towards proprietary IP-driven systems with significant market potential. While a tactical inventory buildup has impacted short-term cash flows, management has ambitious FY27 growth targets and aims to improve cash conversion, positioning the company for sustained, profitable expansion in India's defense ecosystem.
